# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_001_page_001.jpg

---

## Prologue and Saying 1

**1** These are the secret words which the living Jesus spoke and Didymos Judas Thomas wrote down.

**2** And he said: "Whoever finds the interpretation of these words shall not taste death."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Secret words" preserves the programmatic claim of hiddenness — not merely "private" but requiring discovery
- "The living Jesus" is a theological title, not a biographical reference; distinguishes the risen/eternal Jesus as speaker
- "Didymos Judas Thomas" — all three names retained; Didymos (Greek: twin) + Thomas (Aramaic: twin) functions as double identification
- "Finds the interpretation" — *χερμηνεία* implies active labor of understanding, not passive reception
- "Shall not taste death" — Semitic idiom; full force of immortality promise; present tense of ongoing seeking implied

---
